goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide optimized router selection and dispatch behavior without claiming routed MoE or runtime integration.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] parallel and warp router kernels

covered_behavior: router_select_parallel_kernel shared probability storage and top-6 output
router_select_warp_topk_kernel warp-shuffle selection and equal-score index order
optimized single-token and batch launch priority under disable flags
excluded_behavior: runtime graph integration, default route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: executable-local router_select_parallel_kernel and router_select_warp_topk_kernel launch proof
parallel shared-probability and warp-shuffle top-k semantics
not_claimed_in_this_stage: runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal
